launch.title: Ready to play
launch.subtitle: Launch the room to go fullscreen, keep the screen awake and enable sound.
launch.resumeText: The page was reloaded during a game. You can resume it where it stopped.
launch.discardConfirm: Abandon the current game for good?
launch.browserHint: Use Chrome or Edge: they are the only browsers that can drive USB lights.
launch.fullscreenFailed: The browser refused fullscreen. You can retry with the F11 key.

lobby.title: Player registration
lobby.subtitle: One player per desk, from 1 to 4. Press a buzzer to check your desk.
lobby.consent: I agree that the venue keeps my email to send me my results and its news. Kept for 3 years at most, unsubscribe at any time.
lobby.privacyNote: Your email is never shown on screen or shared with other players.
lobby.needPlayer: Register at least one player to start.

errors.consent_required: Tick the consent box, or leave the email empty.

lobby.startFailed: Could not start the game (content unavailable). Try again or use demo mode.

focus.title: Buzzers inactive
focus.text: The game window lost focus: buzzers are no longer received.
focus.action: Click anywhere to reactivate the buzzers

toolbar.abortConfirm: Stop the current game? Current scores will be kept as the result.

staffLobby.title: Today's game
staffLobby.waitingText: The staff registers players and launches the game from the back office. It will show up here automatically.
staffLobby.offlineText: Check the Internet connection of the room PC. A connection is required to start the game.
staffLobby.readyText: Each player can press a buzzer to check their desk.

errors.noContent: No playable theme for this game: add active audio questions in the back office.
errors.gameGone: This game is no longer available (stopped or finished in the back office).
errors.startFailed: Could not start the game. Check the connection and try again.
errors.invalidGame: A player sits at an unknown desk: fix the game in the back office.
errors.noPlayers: No player is registered for this game: add them in the back office.
errors.invalidSetup: This game's format (rounds, questions or players) cannot be played: fix it in the back office.

staffLobby.runningText: This game has already started on this PC: resume it where it stopped.
staffLobby.runningNoSaveText: This game has already started, but its progress is not on this PC: it can only restart from the beginning.
staffLobby.restartConfirm: Restart the game from the beginning? The scores already earned on this PC will be lost.
